agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/filters/others.py: StripWhitespaceFilter._stripws_identifierlist had an inverted ternary (`last_nl = None if token.is_whitespace else token`) that caused non-whitespace identifier tokens to be removed before commas in identifier lists, corrupting output of reindent/reindent_aligned/strip_whitespace formatting (e.g. 'SELECT a, b, c' became 'SELECT , , c'). Changed to `last_nl = token if token.is_whitespace else None` so only stray whitespace/newline tokens before a comma are stripped, matching the documented intent (issue140). Verified via manual repros covering reindent, reindent_aligned (basic and JOIN cases), and the original newline-before-comma stripping behavior, all now correct.
